items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, I didn't know that. But one thing you said was that Red McKenzie sang with the Spirits of Rhythm at the Onyx. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, in Toledo, Ohio. They did "The Toledo Shout," and they released(?) it. He came up with Art Tatum.
Oh, I didn't know that. But one thing you said was that Red McKenzie sang with the Spirits of Rhythm at the Onyx.
